description: Adds Primary Wireset selector to Setting edit form
replace:
<xf:if is="$rpgWiresetPairs is not empty">
	<xf:selectrow name="cv6_rpg_wireset" value="{$setting.cv6_rpg_wireset}"
		label="{{ phrase('cv6_rpg_primary_wireset') }}"
		explain="{{ phrase('cv6_rpg_primary_wireset_explain') }}">
		<xf:option value="">{{ phrase('(none)') }}</xf:option>
		<xf:foreach loop="$rpgWiresetPairs" key="$wsTag" value="$wsTitle">
			<xf:option value="{$wsTag}">{$wsTitle}</xf:option>
		</xf:foreach>
	</xf:selectrow>
</xf:if>
